qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Global #1 in gas chromatography (GC) and top-3 in liquid chromatography (LC) and mass spectrometry (LC-MS). Regulated biopharma QA/QC, clinical diagnostics, and food/environmental testing require validated analytical methods (FDA 21 CFR Part 11, USP monographs). Switching instrument platforms mandates costly, time-consuming method re-validation and regulatory audit risk. Agilent CrossLab Group captures ~42% of enterprise revenue from recurring consumables, columns, reagents, and mission-critical service contracts, sustaining 2-3% annual pricing power. Proven by 10-year median GAAP ROIC of 17.9% and operating ROIC >45%. Primary erosion threats: biopharma spending slowdowns, Chinese domestic instrument substitution policies, and lab budget austerity.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Premier life sciences analytical tools and diagnostics compounder with market-leading positions in chromatography and mass spectrometry. Moat is anchored in regulatory method validation lock-in (FDA/USP/EPA) and a high-margin recurring CrossLab consumables/service engine (>40% of sales). Highly insulated across all 5 macrotrends, with AI-driven drug discovery expanding compound testing volumes and lab automation demand. Fortress balance sheet with net debt under 1.0x net income and 13.2x interest coverage. [5-10Y g: instrument & recurring consumable volume 3.5% + pricing 2.0% + CrossLab services mix 1.0% - cyclical/tariff drag 0.5% + net buybacks 1.5%]
qualitative.evidence: 10-year median GAAP ROIC of 17.9% and operating ROIC of 52.5%. Owner FCF conversion averaged 95% over the past 5 years ($1.14B FCF on $1.30B net income in FY2025). Peak-to-peak Owner EPS compounded from $2.21 in 2017 to $3.63 in 2019, $4.37 in 2021, and reached a new peak of $4.57 in FY2025. Balance sheet exhibits exceptional durability with $1.79B cash against $3.05B long-term debt (net debt $1.26B vs $1.30B net income, repayable in ~1.0 year) and FY2025 interest coverage of 13.2x ($1,479M EBIT / $112M interest).
